sources.snippet: The_frizzy1 — Low-VRAM ComfyUI Workflows The definitive home for every The_frizzy1 ComfyUI workflow. Video, image, 3D and audio workflows for normal GPUs: the newest models as 12 GB "Ultimate" workflows (every mode in one file, core ComfyUI nodes only, tested on an RTX 3060), and GGUF workflows down to 4 GB VRAM.

sources.snippet: The definitive home for every The_frizzy1 ComfyUI workflow. GGUF-quantised image, video and audio generation that runs on as little as 4 GB VRAM. Every model name in this repository was read directly out of the workflow .json files — not guessed. All 13 workflows are model-verified.
